# Contributing to Whisper

Keep changes within the [supported scope](../README.md#scope). Reuse the existing OpenWhispr implementation and UI.

Follow the [development instructions](../README.md#development). Before submitting code changes, run `npm run quality-check`, `npm run i18n:check`, and the documented Electron test command.

Use [issues](https://github.com/softmaxe/whisper/issues) for bugs and feature requests. Include the app version, macOS version, reproduction steps, and redacted errors. Report security vulnerabilities through the [security reporting options](../SECURITY.md#reporting).

Preserve source attribution and licenses.
